name: Knowledge eval v2
description: Runs all 151 items of eval-knowledge-v2 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v3 id.

eval.notes: Second-tier stable facts with in-table distractors — authored because strong models saturate eval-knowledge-v1 at or near 100%.

notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
